_meta.revision: re-judged after ADR-0018 (bucket scope narrowed to callable symbols). The previous file described the pre-narrowing top-10 (mostly DTO type declarations); 5 keys survive, 5 are the Object-protocol/JS-wiring family the narrower scope surfaced.

spring-petclinic-api-gateway/src/main/ja.reason: anOwnerDetails starts a builder chain (OwnerDetails.builder().anOwnerDetails()); chain receiver types are not resolved
build() terminates the same builder chain

spring-petclinic-api-gateway/src/main/re.reason: toggleChatbox is wired through the static template: index.html:64 onclick="toggleChatbox()" — browser dispatch, not an AST call
handleKeyPress is wired at index.html:72 onkeydown="handleKeyPress(event)"
saveChatMessages is assigned at index.html:85 (window.onbeforeunload = saveChatMessages) — a function value handed to a DOM hook
loadChatMessages is assigned at index.html:82 (window.onload = loadChatMessages) — same function-value-to-DOM-hook pattern as its siblings

spring-petclinic-customers-service/src/m.reason: Owner.toString overrides Object.toString and is invoked implicitly by the runtime: OwnerResource.java:89 log.info("Saving owner {}", ownerModel) lets SLF4J call toString on the argument. No static caller can exist for a protocol override — that is not evidence of dead code
Pet.toString is invoked implicitly by the runtime: PetResource.java:84 log.info("Saving pet {}", pet)
Pet.equals overrides Object.equals and is invoked by the collection: Owner.java:67 declares `private Set<Pet> pets` and getPetsInternal() — Set membership/add/remove calls equals at runtime
Pet.hashCode is invoked by the same Set<Pet> membership path (hash-based lookup), not by name
